registration.statement: After Claim 049 and its complete local-response census were officially sealed, the primary Storz et al. record was bound. More than one million trials measured S=(20747 +/- 33)/10000. Its complete interval [20714,20780]/10000 lies above the local-factorization bound two, with a reported P value below 10^-108.
